# Completed independent photon/confidence mathematical review

Root whole-read the photon note and checked its final correction. Governing
PHOTON_CONFIDENCE_AND_MEAN_REFERENCE.md is14548 bytes, SHA256
25bfdb4e5ccab5499fe568491d1a5d2f77c833e2623ec7c355dfd35be49d15ba.
The corrected scope fixes background intensity as deterministic/repeated and
requires N>=2. Random background intensities need extra variance/conditioning;
they are not silently included in the displayed covariance equality.

No remaining mathematical error found at its stated conditional scope. Root
independently checked conditional Poisson mean/covariance, positive source-mean
phase calibration from the common gate, paired centering, eight shared-data
coordinates, independent fixed-rate Poisson dominator coupling, all three
statistical-clipping bias formulas, exact rational Poisson-tail upper bound,
and covariance/mean product-disk transport. Primary Maurer-Pontil2009
[arXiv0907.3740v1](https://arxiv.org/html/0907.3740v1) Theorems4 and10 were checked
directly; the two-sided eight-coordinate empirical-Bernstein radius has the
stated scaling/constants. Timestamp error bounds and added coupling/capture/
initial-preparation budgets were checked. Dependence between the simultaneously
estimated components is not mistaken for independent marginal coverage.

The affinity source theorem's final tree-convention-only update is8114 bytes,
SHA2568334d1121be4d34b28492d9789daa7e4654f448ac3f5aae1bd197c776efd5e18.
Root checked that addition; prior independent sector review is retained in
SECTOR_SPECTRAL_BRIDGE.md. These are substantive completed internal
mathematical acceptances, not a demand for default external/formal audits.

Root also read the population-planning code, including its FK hierarchy,
independent analytic two-window covariance, paired moments, known-cap Poisson
tails,8-coordinate EB/power split and source-gap receipts. No error identified
at the declared numerical planning scope. Root did not independently rerun its
entire ODE or acquire photons. Its population moments do not enter an observed-
data certificate. The current planning script is not an outward-rounded
implementation accepting acquired records, and no such implementation is
inferred from the mathematical specification.

Accepted operation: under the stated stationary finite-state/even/bidirectional
source, passive common gate, condi
